name: monthly-mean-forward-100-v1
initialization: Separate monthly fits from the same declared neutral initialization; no future-month fitted weights.
fitting: Own-month hourly price and actual monthly generation loss only. All actual hours retained; no future targets in fitting, feature scales or transfer.
transfer: For each technology/zone average economic PWL node prices equally over own-month availability-positive hours. Entire next month uses this single curve with actual next-month source/fuel costs, availability and demand. Absent training resources use neutral prior. No weekday/hour stratification.
curves: 12 panels: fit month m vs validation month m+1
Matched training February–December vs forward validation February–December
weighting: Equal eligible zones; within each zone weight month scores by actual hourly coverage. Same eligible-zone set at every update.
december: Training only; January2026 inputs unavailable. No backward wrap or invented forward point.
evaluation: Declare scoring solver before launch. Fast and physical scores must be labelled separately; never interpolate sparse physical checks into a100-update physical curve.
physical_verification: Original coupled-network constraints and existing physical/economic gates remain required; report original physical results separately from fast fitting scores.
reporting: Price MAE every iteration0..100 for every monthly fit/pair, generation errors alongside, timings and per-zone score receipts. No baseline promotion from curves alone.
validation: Retrospective perfect-input model-selection validation; January/February are already development data. Later-month results are not untouched if used for tuning.
existing_research_target: Below10 EUR/MWh equal-zone full8760-hour2025 price MAE; unchanged. This target is not yet achieved or a claim of bid identification.
launch: Latest explicit user instruction authorizes running now with monthly averaging; qualification prerequisite from earlier protocol is superseded. No adoption or accuracy claim.
storage: Budget 2 GiB new outputs. Keep every score, per-zone hourly prices and monthly mean; full parameters every 10 updates, full hourly quantity/flow/generation witnesses initially and finally. Independently audit every live response before pruning. One atomic optimizer state per active month; no large artifacts in Git.
